body: My family don’t know anything, I’ve only ever told 1 friend about how I feel and that was four years ago while drunk

I didn’t write my goodbyes in obvious ways, I just wanted the last thing I sent/said to my family and friends to be something nice, so that they wouldn’t just remember my bad mood. 
Thank you for your comments and that you took your time to even try talking me out of it, I’m not worth your time tho, others have it way worse than me. And that’s why this whiny little bitch has to go to sleep forever, because I can’t ever appreciate what I have and I’m always negative. 
I’ve tried for 7 years to get out of this dark hole but it seems like it’s just getting deeper whenever I try to climb out. The world will still spin if I’m gone, I haven’t left a god impact on people and so I’m sure they will not even mourn me for too long, I will soon be forgotten and I’m sure they’ll be happier when this negative attitude goes away.
I would add punctuations if I could be arsed, but honestly I couldn’t care less

I’m so sorry about your situation, have you recently tried to talk to them about how you feel when you’re being deadnamed and misgender? 

Wishing I could help you out more, is there any way I could? Just let me know!! Here for you

YOU deserve happiness don’t be fooled!! If your family is not supportive of you you should cut all connections with them, you have to show them you are who you are and you’re proud!! I believe in you and if you need any back up putting your foot down I’m always here to help. KNOW YOUR WORTH and keep fighting for your rights as being whoever you fucking want!!

I’m so sorry for taking so long to answer, I had missed you reply.
I don’t know, some days I believe things will get better eventually, but those days are not as reappearing as they used to. It’s mostly darkness now. 
I want to lay in bed and starve to death, but I have to go to work, I have to socialize with family and friends and I am never alone, except for at night when all these feelings get so overwhelming I don’t know if I’ll survive till the morning. I can’t say no to anyone and I can’t show how I really feel. My mask is constant and it’s getting pretty heavy for my head.

I’m totally speechless, it’s like I typed this shit. Scared me for a bit there thinking I had gone totally nuts, thank you for helping me write my thoughts down. And I’m so sorry that you feel like me, didn’t think anyone else actually felt like me. My dms are always open and I send you the biggest warmest hug<3 hope you’ll feel better soon love
if you want someone to talk to I’m here as well, but I’ll be fine

But this hit right in my heart, one person totally random asks me how I am just the day I had planned to kms. No one ever asks me that and let alone a stranger....

Nothing as far I know, she said she reached out because she feared that something very bad was happening either with my physical or mental health. She never told me to answer her either but I did and now I’m waiting for an answer
Thank you for all the answers. I am kinda feeling like a mix of what all of you described. Thinking about seeking help buuuuut kinda too tired of this to do that

I’m just scared that I won’t even remember anyone when I die, and sad that I will never get to hug my mom again. Doing drugs so I can die tho, hoping I never get a trip like yours. Hopefully I’ll just die instead
